faq-page.question1: How many bags can I bring?
faq-page.answer1: The number of pieces of luggage depends on the type of vehicle booked.
faq-page.question2: My trip is canceled, how do I get a refund?
faq-page.answer2:
In the event of cancellation, please contact our customer service as soon as possible at info@brussels-shuttle.be or via our online contact form.
According to our cancellation conditions:

If you cancel your reservation at least 24 hours before your scheduled departure, you will receive a full refund.

If cancellation occurs less than 24 hours before departure, cancellation fees may be applied.

We are committed to processing your request as quickly as possible to ensure a transparent and stress-free experience.
faq-page.answer3:
For your convenience and flexibility, we offer several payment options.

Payment Online payment:
You can pay securely when booking by credit card (Visa, Mastercard, or other accepted cards).

Cash payment:
If you prefer, you can pay directly to your driver at the time of transfer.

We recommend choosing your payment method at the time of booking to ensure a smooth, surprise-free experience.
If you have any questions about payment methods, do not hesitate to contact us at info@brussels-shuttle.be.
faq-page.question4: Can I change my transfer date?
faq-page.answer4:
Yes, you can change the date of your transfer by contacting us at least 24 hours before the scheduled time.

If you wish to make a change less than 24 hours before the scheduled transfer time, we invite you to call us directly on +32 471 010 113. Our teams will do their best to find a quick solution adapted to your situation.

We recommend that you notify us as soon as possible to ensure optimal management of your request.
faq-page.question5: Can I book a last minute transfer?
faq-page.answer5: Yes, you can book a last minute transfer, subject to availability.
faq-page.answer6: Yes, we offer child seats for their safety and comfort, subject to availability.
faq-page.question7: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faq-page.answer7: We track flight schedules in real time.
